item.content:encoded:
Those are the fragments of the St. Manos texts they were able to recover for Father Keene that were attached to Mike’s email. Had the system been working, the entirety of those texts would have been retrieved. ‘Manos’ means Hand. These fragments are all that remain of his teachings.

The text fragments speak of the Serpent (Satan/Dragon/Wyrm/Worm) declaring that it and its offspring (the little serpents) would keep the Fruit of the Tree of Knowledge to themselves, and go forth and devour Knowledge wherever it was found, and to harry and contend with humans, who strive to one dayhave the knowledge and ability to return to paradise, and handle the full Splendor of the Word/total cosmic knowledge and understanding.

The files are fragmented, and the physical copies are ‘missing’. Score one for the Serpent.
